Fan review (Sec 306 / Row S • Baseball, 5 stars), verbatim: "Free food and good place to get a homerun ball, but you will roast in the sun. — In the 300 level sections of the outfield are bleacher seats with back support on them. Also, the tickets include free food, such as hot dogs, peanuts, and nachos, as well as free drinks such as pop and water. The amenities are great, the view is great, and it's your best chance to get a homerun ball. With all of that said, you will absolutely roast in the California sun, because unless you are in the last row of the 300 sections you will not be guaranteed any shade. Once the sun starts setting some sections in left field start getting some shade, but in right field the shade never came until the sun was completely set. If you can handle the heat these are great seats, but if you're like me, do yourself a favor and purchase tickets in the last row of the 300 sections to guarantee you will be in the shade."
